info.name: Hugging Face Text Generation Inference API
info.description:
High-performance toolkit for deploying and serving large language models with optimized inference. Provides both a custom TGI API and an OpenAI-compatible Messages API for chat completions. Supports streaming, tool calling, structured output, grammar constraints, and multi-modal inputs.

Contact Support:
 Name: Hugging Face Support
